class.name: NetwConnection
class.brief_description: Finds servers, and joins or hosts one for its session.
class.description:
One attempt runs at a time, and [member NetwSession.state] follows any peer the session is given, including one a game assigns itself. [codeblock] @onready var connection: NetwConnection = Netw.session(self).connection
func _ready() -> void: connection.endpoint_added.connect(on_endpoint_added) connection.endpoint_removed.connect(on_endpoint_removed) connection.failed.connect(on_failed) visibility_changed.connect(on_visibility_changed) connection.browsing = visible
func on_visibility_changed() -> void: connection.browsing = visible
func on_endpoint_added(endpoint: NetwEndpoint) -> void: var row := ROW.instantiate() row.endpoint = endpoint rows[endpoint] = row list.add_child(row) row.pressed.connect(join.bind(endpoint))
func join(endpoint: NetwEndpoint) -> void: Netw.prepare_join(self, name_edit.text) connection.join(endpoint) [/codeblock] [b]Rows[/b] Each row of [member endpoints] is a [NetwEndpoint]. A [LobbyDirectory] lists its rows while [member browsing] is [code]true[/code], and [method add] lists a server the game already knows. [method invite] records an invitation from any service. [member NetwEndpoint.is_invited] keeps it available to a scene loaded later. [codeblock] func _ready() -> void: connection.invited.connect(_on_invited) for endpoint in connection.endpoints: if endpoint.is_invited: _on_invited(endpoint)
func _on_invited(endpoint: NetwEndpoint) -> void: banner.text = "%s invited you" % endpoint.invited_by Netw.prepare_join(self, name_edit.text) connection.join(endpoint) [/codeblock] [b]Connecting[/b] [method join] and [method host] create the peer, assign it, and settle their [NetwPromise] once the session is online. A failure arrives once through [signal failed]. A player the server refuses also arrives through [signal NetwSession.join_failed], with the same code and reason. [b]Sharing[/b] [member join_address] is the address the server advertises, and [member max_players] is its player limit. A client reads both from the server once its join is accepted, and [signal join_address_changed] reports each change. [member current_endpoint] names the [member NetwEndpoint.peer_class], so a service can share both. [codeblock] func _on_host_pressed() -> void: await connection.host(ENetMultiplayerPeer).wait() connection.join_address = "203.0.113.4:21253" [/codeblock] [b]Defaults[/b] [method set_defaults] fills settings once for every connection through a transport, and the settings a call passes win over them. [codeblock] connection.set_defaults(WebRTCMultiplayerPeer, {ice_servers = my_servers}) [/codeblock] [b]Relay[/b] A WebRTC player behind a strict NAT reaches the others only through a TURN relay. When [code]networked/webrtc/turn_credentials_url[/code] is set, every WebRTC [method host] and [method join] first fetches ICE servers from it and connects with them. [codeblock lang=text] project.godot webrtc/turn_credentials_url="https://networked-turn.example.workers.dev" server cp -r addons/networked/templates/turn_worker my-turn cd my-turn npx wrangler secret put TURN_KEY_ID npx wrangler secret put TURN_KEY_API_TOKEN npx wrangler deploy [/codeblock] When the fetch fails, the session connects with [code]ice_servers[/code] and a warning or error says why. Credentials last [code]TTL_SECONDS[/code], and a relayed connection older than that drops. A game with its own login leaves the URL empty, fetches servers itself and passes them with [method set_defaults].

method.name: add
method.description: Returns the row already listed for that pair, or [code]null[/code] when [param transport] names nothing this build carries. An empty [param address] is listed as the address a join with it reaches, so an ENet row reads [code]localhost[/code].

method.name: cancel
method.description: [signal failed] stays silent and the promise settles with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_SKIP].

method.name: cancel_peer_creation
method.description: The callback of [param ticket] then runs once with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_SKIP].

method.name: create_peer
method.description: Creates a peer for a game that assigns it itself. [param completed] runs once in a later frame as [code]completed(peer, error, detail)[/code], and a peer it leaves unassigned is closed. Returns a ticket for [method cancel_peer_creation].

method.name: defaults
method.description: Returns the settings stored by [method set_defaults] for [param transport]. [codeblock lang=text] Dictionary ┖╴setting name Variant the configured default value [/codeblock]

method.name: diagnostics
method.description: Returns the connected transport's debugging information for [param peer_id], as supplied by [method NetwTransport._diagnostics]. [codeblock lang=text] Dictionary ┖╴transport-defined key Variant debugging information [/codeblock]

method.name: find
method.description: Returns the listed [NetwEndpoint] for [param transport] and [param address], or [code]null[/code] when none is listed.

method.name: host
method.description: Settles with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_ALREADY_IN_USE] while the session is online. Invalid [NetwSessionConfig], [NetwClockConfig] or [NetwLagCompensationConfig] settings reject the promise before a peer is created.

method.name: invite
method.description: Sets [member NetwEndpoint.is_invited] and [member NetwEndpoint.invited_by] before emitting [signal invited]. Reuses the row at [param address]. An invitation to the server the session is already on returns its endpoint and emits nothing. Returns [code]null[/code] if [param transport] is unavailable or the address is empty.

method.name: join
method.description: Settles with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_ALREADY_IN_USE] while the session is online. Configuration errors reject the promise as in [method host].

method.name: register_transport
method.description: Registers the [NetwTransport] script [param type] for this session. Returns [code]false[/code] if registration fails.

method.name: remove
method.description: Removes a row from [method add] or from [signal invited]. An invited row stays listed until this removes it or its [LobbyDirectory] leaves the session. Returns [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] for any other row a [LobbyDirectory] listed.

method.name: set_defaults
method.description: Stores [param settings] for every connection through [param transport], above the transport's own settings and below a listed row's and a call's.

method.name: transport
method.description: A transport named by its peer class, its [Script], a [StringName] or a live peer, empty when this session holds no such transport. [codeblock lang=text] Dictionary ┠╴peer_class StringName the key the transport is registered under ┠╴display_name String what a picker names it ┠╴address_label String what the address input is titled ┠╴address_placeholder String what the empty address input shows ┠╴address_help String the sentence under the address input ┠╴capabilities int NetwConnection.TransportCapability flags ┠╴host_settings Dictionary a host form's settings, defaults included ┠╴client_settings Dictionary a join form's settings, defaults included ┖╴timeout_hint float seconds an attempt waits for the server to answer [/codeblock]

method.name: transports
method.description: Each shaped as [method transport] returns it.

method.name: unregister_transport
method.description: Removes the registered transport named by [param of]. Returns [code]true[/code] when it was removed.

members.member: While [code]true[/code], every [LobbyDirectory] keeps listing and every row from [method add] is probed every [member probe_interval], which costs network traffic.

The connected server, including while hosting, at the address this peer connected through. [code]null[/code] before [constant NetwSession.STATE_ONLINE] or when an assigned peer supplies no address. It can be absent from [member endpoints].
The rows from [method add] come first.

The address other players use to join this server. A server reads its own transport's address, such as its LAN address for ENet, until it sets another. A client reads the address passed to [method join] until its join is accepted, then the server's value. Empty before [constant NetwSession.STATE_ONLINE] or when an assigned peer supplies no address. Only an online server sets it, to at most 1023 bytes of UTF-8. A server behind a router sets its internet address after [method host] settles, and every client follows.

The server's player limit from [member NetwServerInfo.max_players] in [member NetwSessionConfig.server_info]. A client reads the server's value once its join is accepted. [code]0[/code] when no limit is declared or before that.
Seconds between probes of a row from [method add] while [member browsing]. [code]0[/code] probes it once each time browsing starts.

signal.name: endpoint_added
signal.description: Emitted when [param endpoint] is added to [member endpoints].

signal.name: failed
signal.description: Emitted once when an attempt fails, and never for [method cancel]. A connection to it reads the failure of the [NetwPromise] that started the attempt, so a caller may drop that promise. A join the server refuses fails with the [param error] and [param reason] of [signal NetwSession.join_failed], also when the game assigned the peer itself. A join whose connection closes with no answer fails with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_CANT_CONNECT] when the server was never reached, and with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_CONNECTION_ERROR] when it was.

signal.name: invited
signal.description: Emitted when someone invites the player to [param endpoint]. [member NetwEndpoint.invited_by] names the sender, and the player joins only when the game calls [method join].

signal.name: progressed
signal.description: [param ratio] runs from 0 to 1, and is negative when the transport only has a [param message].
